explanation: At GO it is almost always 10 (sometimes 9). At D2 it shows the state reached: about 7 (6-8) for S1 after a common a1 choice, 0-1 for S2 after a common a2 choice, about 2 for S2 after a rare a1 choice, and 2-4 for S1 after a rare a2 choice; at D1 it is about 8 (7-9) when the previous trial was unrewarded and about 5-6 when it was rewarded, sliding down to 2-4 after a long run of rewarded trials, especially late in the episode.
